sourceReview: Exact MIT grant, maintainer scope, selected-file exceptions, Git blob identity, privacy checks and retention/removal lineage; source approval requires a separate recorded decision after packet review
retention: Retain this bounded immutable source/notice packet while referenced; later archival/removal needs impact review. External backup/restore acceptance remains open.
deletionProcedure: Block source use, report exact source-file/document/split/tokenizer/model dependencies, then perform separately reviewed retention or removal; never rewrite immutable artifacts.
